The '''Eighteenth Army''', also known as the '''Night Hammer Command''' or the '''Greater Seswenna's Sector Army''', was one of twenty [[Sector Army/Legends|sector armies]] that comprised the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[civil war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In the late stages of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] conflict, the 18th [[Sector/Legends|Sector]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] was placed under the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], the [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] of [[Greater Seswenna/Legends|Sector 18]], and remained in [[Imperial Military/Legends|military service]] after the Republic's [[Declaration of a New Order|transition]] into the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
===Establishment===
[[File:TCWFilm-BattleofChristophsisfrontline.png|thumb|left|300px|Thousands of clone troopers (pictured) made up the ranks of the Eighteenth Army.]]
In addition to nineteen other [[Sector Army/Legends|sector armies]], the 18th [[Sector/Legends|Sector]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] was first activated by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] that marked the beginning of a [[civil war]]&mdash;known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] Rebellion. As one of the larger components in the [[Order of Battle/Legends|command structure]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic Grand Army]], the standard size of the Eighteenth Army was nearly 150,000 [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] [[Trooper/Legends|units]], but soon increased dramatically as more [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] entered the war. Throughout the duration of the Clone Wars, the Eighteenth was headquartered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] and charged with the defense of the [[Greater Seswenna/Legends|Greater Seswenna]] [[Oversector/Legends|oversector]]. Like the other sector armies, the overall command of the Eighteenth was shared between a highly experienced [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] and a [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] who was appointed by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic. By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the last year of the Clone Wars, the Governor-Generals [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|evolved]] into a permanent class of regional [[Governor/Legends|governors]] known as the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

===Tarkin's heroes===
[[File:TarkinTCW-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|Wilhuff Tarkin (pictured) served as a Moff and leader of the Eighteenth.]]
As the Clone Wars progressed, Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] promoted [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to the rank of Moff, giving him control of the Eighteenth Army and the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]]. A native-born [[Human/Legends|Human]] of Eriadu<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|grandmofftarkin|Tarkin, Grand Moff}}</ref> and a former [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|tarkin|Tarkin}}</ref> Moff Tarkin supplemented the clone units of the Eighteenth with birth-born [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Outland Regions Security Force]] in order to better defend the besieged perimeter around [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. By the waning days of the war, Tarkin and his mix of Eighteenth Army and Outland Regions troops were portrayed as Republic heroes through [[HoloNet/Legends|media]] propaganda due to their extensive action against the Separatists along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian]] and [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

After the conclusion of the Clone Wars, the Old Republic's twenty sector commands, including the Eighteenth Army, were retained by the [[Declaration of a New Order|newly-risen]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, Tarkin ascended to the rank of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] and maintained the Eighteenth Army as a personal power base in his [[Oversector Outer|region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Much of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] was marked by the Empire's massive military buildup and resulted in a [[Imperial Military/Legends|vast army]] far larger than its [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic predecessor]]. Thus, the total infantry force of the Eighteenth Army and all other sector units were increased to approximately 1,572,864 troopers, most of whom were of natural birth as clones became marginalized into a minority status.<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eighteenth Army was first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|reference book]] ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' as the Greater Seswenna's Sector Army.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It was later mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a [[2012]] reference book with extensive information on numerous military themes in ''[[Star Wars]]'', including the history of the Sector Army system.<ref name="TEGTW" />
